[Am]
She

[Verse 1]
[Am]came to me one morning One
[Am]lonely Sunday morning Her
[G]long hair flowing in the
[Am]midwinter wind I
[Am]know not how she found me For
[Am]in darkness I was walking And
[G]destruction lay around me From a
[Am]fight I could not win

[Chorus]
[Am]Ah,
[G]ah, [Am]
[Am][G]ah
[Am]

[Interlude]
[Am]
She

[Verse 2]
[Am]asked me name my foe then I
[Am]said the need within some men To
[G]fight and kill their brothers without
[Am]thought of men or God And
[Am]I begged her give me horses To
[Am]trample down my enemies So
[G]eager was my passion to devour
[Am]this waste of life

[Chorus]
[Am]Ah,
[G]ah, [Am]
[Am][G]ah
[Am]But

[Verse 3]
[Am]she would not think of battle that
[Am]Reduces men to animals So
[G]easy to begin and yet im-
[Am]possible to end For
[Am]she the mother of all men
[Am]Had counciled me so wisely that
[G]I feared to walk alone again And
[Am]asked if she would stay

[Chorus]
[Am]Ah, ah,
[G]ah [Am]
[Am]  [G]
[Am]Oh,

[Verse 4]
[Am]lady, lend your hand, I cried Oh,
[Am]let me rest here at your side
[G]Have faith and trust in me, she said
[Am]and filled my heart withlife There
[Am]is no strength in numbers I've
[Am]no such misconceptions
[G]But when you need me be assured I
[Am]won't be far away

[Chorus]
[Am]Ah,
[G]ah, [Am]
[Am]ah [G]
[Am]Thus

[Verse 5]
[Am]having spoke she turned away And
[Am]though I found no words to say
[G]I stood and watched until I saw her
[Am]black cloak disappear My
[Am]labor is no easier But
[Am]now I know I'm not alone I
[G]find new heart each time I think upon
[Am]that windy day And
[Am]if one day she comes to you
[Am]Drink deeply from her words so
[G]wise Take courage from her as your prize
[Am]and say hello for me
